definitions.explanation: Identifying or singling out a particular item from among others. As a noun, refers to the act of specification or identification.

examples.japanese: {特定|とくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for a specific person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{特定|とくてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were able to identify the culprit.

examples.japanese: {特定|とくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to meet specific conditions.

notes:
USAGE: {特定|とくてい} functions as a no-adjective to mean 'specific/particular' and as a suru-verb to mean 'to identify/specify.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {特定|とくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (a specific ~)
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{特定|とくてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to identify/specify X)
- {特定|とくてい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be identified)

COMPOUNDS:
- {特定|とくてい}⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (specific individual)
- {特定|とくてい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (specific product)
- ⟦{身元|みもと}→身元：15710_mimoto⟧{特定|とくてい} (identification of identity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧ - special (emphasizes being exceptional)
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧ - special, unique (emphasizes rarity)
